decisions.reason: Because it directly extends the firm's core authentication and trusted second-channel communication offer, management would keep it unless several years of uptake clearly fell below aspiration levels.

Although a mobile PDF signature function could be folded into broader signing solutions, it still fits the firm's move toward mobile interaction and digital contracting, so it is more likely to be retained than withdrawn.

As a core security architecture product rooted in the firm's strongest capabilities, it would usually remain on the market unless its performance were clearly and persistently below both internal and peer-based aspirations.

Compliance-oriented payment security remains close to the firm's regulatory-strength customer base, so with some organisational slack the firm would likely continue it while monitoring whether demand stays at satisfactory levels.
